system.description:
Eltor's refined fencing and duelling tradition. Precision over power.

  • Master's Blade: Choose one weapon type — once per round, reroll one missed attack made with it.
  • Connoisseur: Advantage on checks to identify, appraise, or recall lore about the chosen weapon type.
